statement.name: GetPorfolios
statement.sql:
SELECT P.PORFItemId as PortfolioId ,P.GroupName ,P.Description ,P.DisplayText ,P.AdditionalParams ,U.RelativeURL as URL ,U.ExternalSystemCode ,U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode ,E.DimensionValue as ExternalSystemDimensionValue ,CG.LookupCode as PortfolioCategoryCode ,CG.DisplayValue as CategoryDescription ,P.CreatedDate ,CG.DisplayOrder ,P.WindowType FROM LU_PFM_PORF_Item P Join PFM_CORE_PredefinedPage U on U.COREPredefinedPageID = P.COREPredefinedPageID Join dbo.ExternalSystemDimensionValue E on U.ExternalSystemCode = E.ExternalSystemCode and U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = E.ExternalSystemDimensionCode join LU_PFM_PORF_Category CG on CG.LookupCode = P.CategoryCode
order by DisplayOrder Desc, Description asc
